summary: The registrant, Rithm Perpetual Life Residential Trust, an SEC- filer, released its monthly NAV per share as of May 31, 2026 in an Item 8.01 Other Events 8-K. The filing discloses NAV of $20.1602 per Class J share and $20.2647 per Class E share, with total NAV of $131.4 million on 6,516,613 shares outstanding. This is a routine periodic NAV disclosure, not a special situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic change is announced. The filing simply updates shareholders on the trust's net asset value, consistent with its ongoing reporting obligations.
